items.title: 'Nothing off the table': Police update on search for four-year-old Gus leaves more questions than answers
items.description: Police declared the disappearance of Gus Lamont a major crime due to "a number of inconsistencies and discrepancies" emerging during the four-month investigation.

items.title: I have a question for the men who had no questions about Epstein
items.description: The millions of pages of documents related to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein have shone a light on how many influential men were ready to disregard the experiences of countless women.

items.title: US wants world to follow Australia into 'club of nations' to counter China
items.description: The US is urging dozens of countries to follow Australia's lead and sign onto a plan to stop relying on China for the critical minerals used in modern technology.

items.title: Breaking: Underworld figure Tony Mokbel a free man after drug case abandoned
items.description: Prosecutors have abandoned a drug trafficking case against underworld figure Tony Mokbel following his release from prison last year.

items.title: Judge criticises Abbott's 'misconceived' comments over harbour bridge protest
items.description: The former prime minister said it should not be for judges to decide when a political protest was justified, which are remarks NSW's top judge called "regrettable".

items.title: Live: Jane Hume says Liberals can go it alone without Nationals, One Nation
items.description: Liberal senator Jane Hume says her party can go at it alone without joining forces with the Nationals or One Nation. Follow live.

items.title: Inside David Littleproud's 'kingdom of Maranoa'
items.description: As One Nation announces its plan to open an office in Longreach, the ABC speaks to voters in David Littleproud's electorate to get their thoughts on the Nationals leader.

items.title: What Herzog has said about Gaza, and why he won't be arrested in Australia
items.description: When Israel's president lands in Australia this weekend, he can expect an official red carpet treatment. But he will be all too aware of the controversy his visit is generating.

items.title: Live: ASX opens lower, RBA governor addresses economics committee
items.description: The ASX has opened lower, while RBA governor Michele Bullock addresses the economics committee. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: TV host Savannah Guthrie's missing mother is 'still out there,' police say
items.description: US investigators believe the missing mother of Today show host Savannah Guthrie is "still out there" despite having no proof she is still alive.

items.title: End of US-Russia nuclear weapons pact 'could not come at a worse time'
items.description: The last remaining nuclear arms pact between Russia and the United States has expired after Donald Trump rejected an offer from his Russian counterpart.

items.title: Satellite imagery shows US military build up near Iran ahead of nuclear talks
items.description: Ahead of planned nuclear talks between the United States and Iran, satellite imagery reveals how the US is positioning itself for potential military escalation.

items.title: An ex-jihadi and terror experts agree on one thing about extremism
items.description: As police probe what led to the deadliest terror attack on Australian soil in December, radicalisation researchers and a former Islamic State group supporter have shed light on how people are recruited.

items.title: ATO debt continues to drive record level of calls to financial helpline
items.description: Financial counsellors say small businesses struggling to pay debts owed to the tax office are driving calls to Australia's Small Business Debt Helpline higher.

items.title: Would changes to the capital gains tax discount lower house prices?
items.description: Labor has not ruled out changes to the capital gains tax discount but wants any tax changes to improve housing affordability.

items.title: Everything you need to know about the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics
items.description: Australia is tipped for enormous success over the next couple of weeks so now might be a good time to clue yourself up. Here's everything you need to know about the 2026 Winter Games.

items.title: WA premier writes letter to 13yo Austin Appelbee after 'extraordinary' swim
items.description: Premier Roger Cook writes to the 13-year-old, who made international headlines after swimming 4 kilometres in rough seas to raise the alarm and save his family.

items.title: Sisters aged two and 13 die in hospital after Queensland house fire
items.description: Two children die in hospital after a fire ripped through a Queensland home earlier this week.

items.title: The Flowers of Manchester fell, but the club rose from the ashes
items.description: On a snowy February afternoon in 1958, the football team that many were calling the greatest that Britain had ever produced stopped to refuel at Munich Airport. The plane would never take off, and the Flowers of Manchester would take years to bloom again.

items.title: NT paying 'millions of dollars a day in interest' to stay afloat
items.description: The NT Treasurer Bill Yan outlines his plans for the NT's financial future, saying private investment will be key to turning the debt around.

items.title: Parton confirms serious Greens–Liberals talks to bring down ACT Labor
items.description: The leader of the Canberra Liberals has confirmed for the first time that talks with the ACT Greens about forming a coalition to unseat the ACT Labor government were "very serious".

items.title: A key recommendation of the Bondi Junction stabbing inquest is already saving lives
items.description: An inquest into the Bondi Junction stabbing has recommended that the NSW government support long-term accommodation for homeless people experiencing mental health issues. It's a model that is already finding success.

items.title: Man to face court after allegedly threatening politicians on social media
items.description: Police allege the 39-year-old posted threatening messages to parliamentarians on X in December.

items.title: Man and woman charged with domestic violence-related murder in NSW
items.description: Two people in their 40s have been charged over the alleged domestic violence murder of a 48-year-old woman in Goulburn earlier this year.

items.title: Social housing plan for land that 'frequently' floods shocks locals
items.description: Locals, the council and a Queensland MP are questioning the wisdom of a Queensland government plan to build dwellings in an area of Burketown known to flood.
